response.enhanced_information: Option 'acd' (Sulfonamides, Methotrexate, Nitrous oxide) is the most accurate in reflecting drugs that inhibit folic acid metabolism. Methotrexate directly inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, impacting human folic acid metabolism. Nitrous oxide indirectly affects it by disrupting the folate cycle via cobalamin oxidation. Sulfonamides inhibit folate synthesis in bacteria, indirectly relevant during infections.
